summary.text: Beth Wessel-Kroeschell is a Democratic state representative from Iowa House District 49 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia dates Wessel-Kroeschell's tenure in the Iowa House to 2005.

paragraphs.text: Beth Wessel-Kroeschell was born in Ames, Iowa, and graduated from Ames High School, according to Ballotpedia.
Wessel-Kroeschell earned a bachelor's degree in English from the University of Northern Iowa in 1985 and a master's degree in public administration from Iowa State University in 1987.
Wessel-Kroeschell's career experience includes working as an events coordinator with Reiman Gardens, and Wessel-Kroeschell has served on the board of directors of Friendship Ark.
In the 2025-2026 session Wessel-Kroeschell was assigned to the House Education, House Human Resources, House Judiciary and Public Safety committees.
In 2023-2024 Wessel-Kroeschell was ranking member of the House Human Resources Committee.
